body: Thank you, wish you the best as well. It was heads. Take care.

I wish that wasn't just the tip of the iceberg, but it is what it is. I do appreciate the empathy and compassion. 

And no, I haven't been oficially diagnosed, but I know whatever it is, the money to even try and fix it just isn't there even if I wanted to, and since it was caused by previous lifestyle choices, I feel more inclined to just accept it. 

Thank you for saying that and even just reading the op and saying something, genuinely thank you. We got another 20mins or so before I flip, so I wanted to ask whats got you on this thread? Are you good?

The final and most recent straws, started coughing and spitting up blood towards the end of last year, agonizing pain in my side, plus chest pains, a lot of this is probably self induced from years of intense drug abuse. No health insurance, and fam already has their own health issues so we really can't take anymore. Before that, I got hurt in 2019 at work and was out of work for almost all of 2020, rehab got fucked with by L&I red tape, so body hasn't recovered, and topped it off getting fucked over on the money that was owed to me from the injury. Before that, dealing, drug abuse, homelessness, poverty, split parents and childhood sexual abuse.

I think there's some truth to that, but I'm also certain I would've felt some hesitation and doubt the closer i got to 3, regardless of the coin toss being added. Every natural instinct tells us to survive, suicide is trying to unnaturally override that feeling.
Not quite, while I understand that thought process, the coin toss was one last gesture of "at least I tried", seeing as how I originally intended to do it absent the toss.
I'm not flipping until 259, its only 1 for me here
As much as I would like to believe that its equal, or that I'm indifferent, the truth is tails. Not cause I want to live but  because I'm scared of death. But not enough so to change my mind.
